variables.name: NEO4J_URI
variables.title: Neo4j URI
variables.description: Bolt URI for the Neo4j instance (e.g. neo4j+s://<dbid>.databases.neo4j.io or neo4j://localhost:7687). Passed to the server as NEO4J_MCP_URI.

variables.name: NEO4J_USERNAME
variables.title: Neo4j Username
variables.description: Neo4j database username (usually neo4j). Passed as NEO4J_MCP_USERNAME.

variables.name: NEO4J_PASSWORD
variables.title: Neo4j Password
variables.description: Neo4j database password. Passed as NEO4J_MCP_PASSWORD.

variables.name: NEO4J_DATABASE
variables.title: Neo4j Database
variables.description: Target database name. Required in STDIO mode since MCP server 2.0 (no default); use neo4j unless you created another database. Passed as NEO4J_MCP_DATABASE.

variables.name: NEO4J_READ_ONLY
variables.title: Read-Only Mode
variables.description: Set to true to hide write tools (server default: false). Recommended: true for exploration.

variables.name: NEO4J_TELEMETRY
variables.title: Telemetry
variables.description: Set to false to disable telemetry (server default: true).

variables.name: NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL
variables.title: Log Level
variables.description: Server log level, e.g. info, debug, warn, error (default: info).

variables.name: NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT
variables.title: Log Format
variables.description: Server log format: text or json (default: text).

variables.name: NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE
variables.title: Schema Sample Size
variables.description: Number of nodes sampled for schema inference (default: 100).
